items.context: HODL15Capital (@HODL15Capital, 85.015 seguidores, en inglés), post con imagen del dashboard de Bitcoin del sitio de Strategy: BTC está 12% bajo la media de 200 semanas y 52,5% bajo el máximo histórico; dice que solo unos pocos días ofrecieron mejores puntos de entrada en los últimos 10 años. "Bullish". ~8 min, 11 likes, 0 respuestas, 1,2K vistas.
items.suggested_text:
Those two numbers are worth reading together. Distance below the 200-week average tells you how stretched $BTC is against its long-term trend; drawdown from the high tells you how much of the cycle's excess has already been flushed. Neither one marks a bottom on its own, but together they describe a market that has given back most of its froth.

That's the logic behind the Market Temperature index I track: MVRV, price vs. the 200-week average, drawdown from the record and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, 25% each. It went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days, close to the very bottom of its range.

The hard part was never spotting the zone. It's that "only a few days offered better entries" is something you only get to say looking back.
